register: ti (informal singular, as Croatian health and wellness apps use; lower-case ti/tvoj). Straight register: calm, plain, patient-leaflet Croatian (standard Croatian, HZJZ/zdravlje.hr style terms; tjedan, liječnik, zaslon). Wry register: dry, warm humour, never crude. No exclamation marks. Croatian quotation marks „…“. Placeholders that would need case endings are written as label: value.
gender: Feminine forms where Croatian grammar marks the user's gender and a neutral construction is awkward (past tense: 'zabilježila si', 'spremna si'); neutral constructions preferred where natural. Clinician: generic 'liječnik' (bilješke za liječnika, posjet liječniku), as Croatian patient materials use it.
